title: Handicap Index Season Leaderboard
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=handicap:index
| stats avg(handicap_index) as avg_value max(handicap_index) as peak_value count as sessions by season
| sort avg_value
description: Ranks season values by average and peak handicap index, helping you see where handicap index performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which season contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `season` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of season, average handicap index, and peak handicap index.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which season areas give you the strongest handicap index results.
